headline: Google launches first datacenter chip into orbit for space data centers
summary: Google launched its first advanced chip into orbit as part of research into space-based data centers, finding that SpaceX's Starship would need to launch roughly 1,800 times to make the concept feasible.

claims.statement: Google launched its first advanced chip into orbit as part of research into space-based data centers.

sources.quote: Google launched its first advanced chip into orbit to pave the way for space data centers.
